references.text: This verse describes the second day of the Feast of Tabernacles with a corresponding offering structure - bulls, rams, and one-year-old lambs without defect, showing the consistent pattern for festival offerings.
The third day of the Feast of Tabernacles with the same type of offering - bulls, rams, and lambs without defect. Shows the daily reduction in the number of bulls throughout the feast.
The fifth day of the Feast of Tabernacles follows the same pattern with bulls, rams, and fourteen one-year-old lambs without defect.
The introduction to the offerings of the Feast of Tabernacles establishing the basic pattern with bulls, rams, and fourteen one-year-old lambs without defect.
The requirement for animals without defect (tamim) for burnt offerings is repeated here, showing the consistent standard for all festival sacrifices.
The fundamental commandment about the Feast of Tabernacles lasting seven days with fire offerings to the Lord, which Numbers 29:23 details further.
After returning from exile, the Israelites celebrated the Feast of Tabernacles and presented the daily number of burnt offerings as prescribed.
